title: Global majorant frame contractions: conditional κ = 0.000662502871668435
body:
## Summary

This is a proposed continuation of the maintainer-reviewed #186 coordinated-frame / completed-entrance-bank construction.

It applies the repository's existing concavity-majorant / directed-min-cut frame-search machinery to the h=22 coordinated complex witness.

The resulting exact conditional headline is

\[
\kappa =
\frac{662502871668435}{10^{18}}
=
0.000662502871668435,
\]

up from the preceding selected package value

\[
0.000661885549259598.
\]

This is an approximately 0.09326724% relative increase in the headline exponent saving.

## Complex witness improvement

The complex saving improves from

\[
662323931899051/10^{18}
\]

to

\[
662942072695346/10^{18}.
\]

The search selects 923 operation contractions and increases the explicit physical-frame overrides from 13,085 to 13,810 while preserving the 46 terminal sinks and final physical width \(W=13326\).

The floating min-cut objective is used only to nominate a candidate. Acceptance is by the repository's exact physical-frame, chronology, formal-column, rational-moment, and balanced-assembly checks.

No global-optimality claim is made.

## Reproducibility

The new replayable receipt is in:

`research/pr186-majorant-frame-search/`

It includes the frozen predecessor witness, deterministic search code, search result, replay transcript, replay-equality receipt, and SHA-256 bindings.

The replay regenerates the exact certified 13,810-entry physical-frame witness.

## Verification

Passed locally:

- `python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py`
- `make entrance-bank-verify`
- `make verify-joint`
- `sha256sum -c research/pr186-majorant-frame-search/SHA256SUMS`
- exact byte comparison showing the receipt's frozen baseline files match the parent selected witness

A full `make verify` progressed through the earlier verification groups and reached `verify-joint`. It initially stopped because the historical joint-dual source manifest still pinned the previous root `README.md` hash. That single stale metadata pin was refreshed, its two derived joint-dual receipts were regenerated, and `make verify-joint` then passed completely.

## Scope

This remains conditional on the inherited analytic, recursion, compiler, routing, precision/recovery, and prime-supply interfaces.

It is not an unconditional integer-multiplication theorem, a global optimum, or a new formal proof of the complete theorem.

## Attribution

The underlying coordinated construction and all predecessor contributions retain their existing attribution.

`@dataisfire` contributed this additional replayable global-majorant contraction pass and integration into the selected exact certificate.

This adapts existing repository concavity-majorant / directed-min-cut machinery; no novelty claim is made for minimum cut, concavity/majorization, the underlying theorem, or predecessor scalar/rematching constructions.

Developed with substantial OpenAI ChatGPT assistance.
